subject: Log export formats, snapshot cadence, and cross-region residency
body:
From: Beth Turner <beth.turner@acme-health.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-health.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Request: audit/log export formats, residence, and snapshot cadence

Hi Michael —

Quick follow-up from our compliance review: Acme needs a consolidated answer on how Redwood provides audit and access log exports for customers in the US region. Specifically:

- Supported export formats (for ingestion into our SIEM)
- Whether exports/snapshots include PII or are redacted by default
- Typical retention windows and whether we can request ad hoc historic extracts beyond the retention window
- Cross-region export options (we'd like copies in our eu-west S3 for DR)
- Proof-of-export / evidence records we can present to auditors

Could you send a short summary plus any sample schema and the expected lead time for a one-off export request?

Thanks,
Beth Turner
Director, InfoSec
Acme Health

---

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Beth Turner <beth.turner@acme-health.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: audit/log export formats, residence, and snapshot cadence

Hi Beth —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise breakdown you can use in the audit packet; I attached a lightweight export schema (export-schema-v1.csv) for your SIEM team.

Summary:
- Formats: We support JSONL (line-delimited JSON) and Apache Parquet for bulk exports. For streaming or near-real-time forwarding, we can push to an S3-compatible endpoint using compressed JSONL (gz).
- Fields and PII: Audit/access logs are collected with user identifiers (internal account IDs and email) and request metadata. PII exposure is minimised: by default we do NOT include full user profile fields (SSNs, etc.). If your compliance team requires additional redaction, we can apply field-level redaction at export time (configured per export job).
- Retention windows (default):
  - Access logs (web/API): 90 days by default for hosted accounts; Dedicated/Private deployments can be configured up to 3 years as part of contract addendum.
  - Audit trails (admin actions, config changes): 365 days default for hosted; longer on Dedicated/Private.
  - Short-term session traces (detailed KV cache traces): 7 days.
- Historic extracts: We can provide ad hoc extracts for data within the retained window. For data beyond retention we cannot retrieve it unless you have an archival snapshot (see snapshotting below).
- Snapshotting / archival: We offer scheduled snapshot exports (daily or weekly) to a customer-managed S3 bucket. Snapshots are full exports of the chosen log class and are retained per your bucket lifecycle policy. This is the recommended approach if you need long-term storage beyond the platform retention.
- Cross-region exports: We can export directly to an S3 bucket in another region (eu-west) or to your SFTP endpoint. We do not replicate operational log stores between Redwood regions automatically for hosted accounts unless requested; cross-region copies are implemented as export jobs.
- Proof-of-export: Each export job produces a signed manifest with timestamps, SHA256 checksums for each file, and a job ID. We can provide the manifest and the export job metadata (operator ID, start/end time) as audit evidence.
- Lead time: One-off exports for data within retention: typical SLA is 48 hours for standard requests. Large historic reconstruction or cross-region encryption key work may take longer (~3–5 business days).

Attachments: export-schema-v1.csv (contains field list + example payload rows).

Let me know if you want a short table I can drop straight into the auditor packet.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Beth Turner <beth.turner@acme-health.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 12:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: audit/log export formats, residence, and snapshot cadence

Beth —

Quick clarifications from the product/ops side:

- Default retention numbers above are for Hosted. If Acme is on a Dedicated plan we can formalise a longer retention (e.g., 2–3 years) in the contract and set the retention flags on export accordingly.
- Encryption / KMS: Exports to customer buckets can be encrypted with your customer-managed KMS key (we support AWS-KMS ARNs). If you supply the key policy and bucket ARN we will configure the export job to use server-side encryption with that KMS key.
- Redaction controls: We offer pre-export transformations — regex-based scrubbing and column-level drop — which are applied as part of the export job if you request them in the job spec.
- Snapshot cadence: Typical customer patterns we see:
  - Daily incremental exports (only new events) into Parquet for analytics
  - Weekly full snapshots retained in customer S3 for archival/forensics
  - Monthly immutable snapshots for long-term compliance (your bucket lifecycle handles immutability)

I've also attached a sketch of the snapshot schedule (snapshot-schedule.png). Happy to coordinate with your SRE to test a one-week trial export.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Beth Turner <beth.turner@acme-health.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 14:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: audit/log export formats, residence, and snapshot cadence

Beth —

Looping in our runbook for evidence requests and a sample export job definition (link below). Quick operational notes that auditors ask for often:

- Evidence records we provide: job manifest (signed), presigned object list (time-limited), KMS usage logs (if CMK used), and an audit log entry linking the export job ID to the account.
- Retention vs. hold: If you need us to preserve data beyond retention for an active investigation, we place a legal/administrative hold on the logs which prevents deletion for the specified period. That requires an internal approval and a short form we can send.
- Deletion proof: When deletion is performed (for example, end of retention or on request), we provide a deletion report with hashes of deleted files and the job id. Note: deletion of platform-managed data in Hosted accounts is irreversible unless a snapshot was sent to your bucket.

Link to runbook and sample job: https://drive.redwood-internal/company/runbooks/log-export-runbook.pdf

If this looks good, Michael and I can schedule a 30-min tech call this week to walk through a test export to your eu-west S3 bucket and validate keys/policies.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
